resources.string:
WinEntry helps small retail businesses manage daily stock, sales and purchases. All data is stored on your device.

─── Sign-In ───
Google Sign-In establishes your identity only. No data is read or written automatically. The app works fully after sign-in — local stock entry, daily records, purchases and Excel export — with no further setup.

─── Registration Required for Admin's Drive Space ───
Access to the Admin's drive space requires a one-time registration. Go to Settings → Business Info, fill your details and tap 'Save & Register'. Registration unlocks:
• Download of Admin's standard product list
• Loading sample test data
• Cloud backup to Admin's workspace sheet

Data shared at registration: Business Name, Owner Name, Phone, Location, Android version, App version. No payment or financial data is ever collected.

─── What is NEVER accessed ───
• Your personal Google Drive files
• Any Google services beyond your sign-in identity
• Any data other than what you enter yourself

You can sign out at any time from the Home screen. Registration details can be updated anytime from Settings → Business Info.
